stance: Agent identity is hardening into formal cryptographic verification at the web-server layer, even as autonomous actors still register themselves through conventional directories and preference signals.
adoption_shape: Cloudflare has moved rapidly to enforce IETF Web Bot Auth draft-00 requirements by mandating tag parameters, banning HMAC signatures, and resolving algorithm serialization bugs, whereas major agent operator Anthropic has adopted standard IETF aipref opt-out signals and directory listings while keeping ClaudeBot robots.txt directives authoritative.
new_entrants: Anthropic introduced its Claude-Agent browser automation bot into the Known Agents directory to operate on behalf of users, while a new IETF submission by Vilgalys seeks to establish a dedicated Signed-Agent-Metadata HTTP header field within the Web Bot Auth Working Group.
watch_for: The adoption of cryptographic Web Bot Auth headers by interactive bots like Anthropic's Claude-Agent, or the resolution of upstream parsing bugs that prevent proper verification of Signature-Agent header dictionary members.
